## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Zhuǎnyǒu jīng* (T576, *Bhava-saṅkrānti-sūtra*) is a one-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra translated by Buddhaśānta 佛陀扇多 ([佛陀扇多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%9B%E9%99%80%E6%89%87%E5%A4%9A)). The title rendered literally is "Sūtra on Transmigrating Existence"; *zhuǎnyǒu* 轉有 = *bhava-saṅkrānti*, the passage of *bhava* (existence) from one life to the next, treated here through the simile of a reflection (*pratibimba*).

**Abstract**

A brief Mahāyāna treatise in sūtra form on consciousness, rebirth, and the absence of a transmigrating self, datable to Buddhaśānta's translation activity at Luòyáng and Yè under the Northern Wèi (525–539). It is a parallel to the [KR6i0207](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0207) 大方等修多羅王經 by Bodhiruci I and to a Tibetan version preserved as *Srid pa 'pho ba'i mdo*.
